title: Vampire Vape Shortz Cool Green Slush
description: Vampire Vape’s Shortz collection contain some amazing Slushy-inspired e-liquids and Cool Green Slush is no exception. With a bright, zesty Lime on the inhale, the wave of crushed ice that greets you on the exhale is utterly refreshing, and unfailingly moreish. These shortfill bottles contain 50ml of nicotine-free liquid, with 10ml of extra space within the bottle to accommodate your nicotine shot of choice. This allows you to create a liquid with your own desired nicotine strength. Typically, adding a 10ml nicotine shot to a 50ml shortfill will give you 60ml of 3mg e-liquid. Once you have added your preferred amount of nicotine, make sure to shake the contents of the shortfill bottle well.
